name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

facts.business: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited is a pure-play health insurer in India, offering retail health, group health, personal accident, and travel insurance products with no exposure to motor or property lines.

auditor.name: S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP and Nangia & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding application for forbearance of Expenses of Management (EOM) exceeding allowable limit for FY2024-25 with IRDAI, approval pending; consequential impacts cannot be determined.

key_risks: Claim provisioning involves high degree of judgement and estimates for IBNR/IBNER
Expenses of Management (EOM) exceeding allowable limit under IRDAI regulations, forbearance application pending
Group Health segment carries higher claims volatility, particularly for large corporate accounts
Regulatory changes including 1/n accounting for long-term products mandated by IRDAI from October 1, 2024
facts.related_party_note: Due from subsidiaries/holding company: Nil as at March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025. Rent and other deposits include ₹2,213 lakhs (previous year: ₹2,500 lakhs) paid to Directorate General of GST Intelligence (DGGI).
